title: At Velasco, Santa Anna agrees not to take up arms against the people of Texas
summary: At Velasco, Santa Anna agrees not to take up arms against Texas during that war.
body: The public Treaty of Velasco says General Antonio Lopez de Santa Anna agrees that he will not take up arms, nor cause them to be taken up, against the people of Texas during the present war of independence. The agreement is extracted from a captured president-general. Mexico's later refusal to treat it as binding is a separate political fact not printed as a Mexican ratification on this page. The wording on the page includes: "Army, of the other part. Article 1st General Antonio Lopez de Santa Anna agrees that he will not take up arms, nor will he exercise his influence to cause them to be taken up against the people of Texas, during the present war of Independence. Article 2nd All hostilities between the mexican and texian troops will cease immediately both on land and water.
